name: Five Days At Jumpscare Academy
source: As a student in Jumpscare Academy, you get 5 Days/Nights to build up love for the characters and get to 100%! Characters have three stages of affection: Acquantaince, Friend, and Significant Other! You'll have to talk to them, answer their questions, and hug/kiss/etc with them to build up love
